dct_description_sm: Coordinates are approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Shows topography, drainage, shoals, islands surrounding continent, political boundaries.
Illustrations of flora and fauna, ships.
Appears in Fernández de Medrano's Geografiá o moderna descripcion de el Mundo, Antwerp, 1709.
